exposure: Birth by Caesarean section (of the female offspring)
outcome: Risk of Caesarean section delivery (for the female offspring's own first child)
cohort: The study included 23,605 women (female offspring) whose births and their own subsequent first deliveries were recorded in the Nova Scotia Atlee Perinatal Database.
finding: Women born by Caesarean section had an adjusted relative risk of 1.36 (95% CI 1.30, 1.43) for delivering their first child by Caesarean section, compared to women born vaginally.
mod_finding: Birth by Caesarean section is associated with a 36% increased risk of women delivering their first child by Caesarean section.
